svg.title: Separate study designs, decision pathways and later analysis roles
svg.desc: Protocol facts verified against the current main manuscript and supplement. PaySim and BankSim show exact step bounds. IEEE-CIS percentages use all 590540 labelled rows as denominator. Split cells are schematic, not proportional bars. No empirical curves or outcomes are simulated. Studies are not pooled.
